what: the 50 most-mentioned gallery people: their references by pose, and up to 20 more Commons files each, drawn from what Commons lists as depicting them or in their category, through the reference gates; a side-on face (SIDE_ON) agrees when it scores at or above the consistency threshold (0.3811) against the person's medoid. A measurement: nothing is stored or added
statement: Of the 50 most-mentioned people, 38 have a side view the gallery would keep: one among their references, or a side-on Commons face that agrees with their medoid (67 agreeing of 89 side-on faces in 412 single-face files drawn). Enough to fetch for.

pose_failures.what: the sample's confirmed side-on recognition failures, scored against the side-on Commons faces the census found for their person

fetched.statement: 89 side views fetched: the consistency check kept 55 and refused 24 of the 79 it checked (30%), 7 of them since admitted by a person; 10 never reached the check

reviewed.what: references the consistency check refused that a person has judged (review-side-views: side-on references of the most-mentioned people): a refusal is right when the reference shows someone else
reviewed.statement: A person judged 40 refusals of the consistency check: 30 right (someone else), 9 wrong (the same person), 1 unsure; the check's refusals were right 75% of the time. The check keeps 1 of them now
